This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.
The two pumps supply the accumulator by the pressure oil.

The fitting location of the pump modules on the oil tank is freely selectable in 
case of failure the pump on modules can be exchange during operation the pump 
modules are fitted vertically pumps suction return and leakage pipes are in the 
oil tank where as all return and leakage oil are below the oil level, motors pressure limiting valves 
minimizes connections 
and cocks are above oil tank.

and tested

A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.

Power
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.
The two pumps supply the accumulator by the pressure oil.
The fitting location of the pump modules on the oil tank is freely selectable in 
case of failure the pump on modules can be exchange during operation the pump 
modules are fitted vertically pumps suction return and leakage pipes are in the 
oil tank where as all return and leakage oil are below the oil level, motors pressure limiting valves 
minimizes connections 
and cocks are above oil tank.
The first draft initiated 
and tested 
 by eng.
Abd El-Salam Abd El-Hamed Metwaly, accepted by eng.
Abd El-Karem Mousa Ahmed: mechanical maintenance director,
approved by eng. Yousef Mahmoud Aly: 
General Director 
of Esna Hydraulic PS, 
and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality control general director 
and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The unit must be out of service 
 (at monthly, annually, overhaul, capital maintenance)

Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 tool set includes manual wrenches ... etc.
Some special tools (mechanical seal 
 - ball bearing - etc).
Blanco 1 ton
Work to be Carried Out
Check the check valve - unloaded valve - adjustable pressure limiting 
 valve
Check the suction strainer and clean
Check the ball bearing and mechanical seal
Check the direction of rotation
